pages.title: Princess Zelda Holding a Sheikah Slate in Her Traveler Outfit From Breath of the Wild Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Zelda holds a Sheikah Slate in her Breath of the Wild traveler outfit in this printable coloring page, with a braided crown and long boots. The slate's eye emblem, patterned waist panels, fingerless gloves, and small hip pouch provide fine details, while distant cliffs and castle spires establish the background.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Holding the Tri Rod Beside Tri From Echoes of Wisdom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Princess Zelda holding the Tri Rod beside Tri from Echoes of Wisdom, with a jeweled headband and flowing cape over her gown. Twisting rod branches surround a floating triangle, while Tri's outlined face, the dress's geometric emblems, and the belt's round clasp add smaller coloring sections.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Playing the Goddess's Harp From Skyward Sword Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Zelda plays the Goddess's Harp from Skyward Sword in this printable coloring page, with long hair, wrapped side braids, and wide sleeves beside the instrument. Curled harp arms, narrow strings, a decorated belt, and patterned dress borders add fine sections around the broad flowing skirt on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Sheik Playing a Harp at the Temple of Time From Ocarina of Time Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Sheik playing a harp at the Temple of Time, standing before a pointed arch and large Triforce design above the stone steps. Wrapped forearms, a cloth face covering, and the chest eye emblem detail the Ocarina of Time costume, while harp strings provide smaller enclosed sections.

pages.title: Link Wearing the Champion's Tunic with the Master Sword and Hylian Shield from Breath of the Wild Coloring Page
pages.description: Link holds the Master Sword and Hylian Shield in this printable coloring page, wearing the Champion's Tunic from Breath of the Wild with belted straps and boots. Large shield emblems contrast with smaller buckle shapes, bracer panels, and the Sheikah Slate at his hip, while the plain background keeps the figure prominent.

pages.title: Link Playing the Ocarina of Time Beside Navi in Kokiri Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Link playing the Ocarina of Time beside Navi in Kokiri Forest, with closed eyes and both hands around the small instrument. A sword and shield rest on his back, while finger holes, belt buckles, tree bark, and scattered grass add details around the broad tunic and pointed cap.

pages.title: Link Riding Epona Across Hyrule Field Coloring Page
pages.description: Link rides Epona across Hyrule Field in this printable coloring page, holding the reins as the horse lifts one foreleg beneath a flowing mane and tail. The bridle rings, saddle straps, and Link's belt create smaller sections, while broad horse contours and distant castle spires define the open landscape.

pages.title: Link Flying Over the Great Plateau with His Paraglider From Breath of the Wild Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Link flying over the Great Plateau with his Breath of the Wild paraglider, gripping both handles beneath a large Hylian crest. The glider's lashings, Link's straps, and the Sheikah Slate at his hip add fine details, while cliffs, scattered trees, a tower, and distant buildings fill the landscape.

pages.title: Link and Marin Standing Below the Wind Fish's Egg From Link's Awakening Coloring Page
pages.description: Link and Marin stand below the Wind Fish's Egg in this printable coloring page, looking upward from a flower-dotted shore beneath the large spotted egg. Marin wears a flower in her hair and clasps her hands, while Link's shield, short sword, and pointed cap add details to the Link's Awakening scene.

pages.title: A Korok with a Leaf Mask Standing Among Woodland Plants Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Korok with a leaf mask standing among woodland plants, holding a tall sprouting twig beside a rounded mushroom and scattered stones. Fine veins divide the broad mask and surrounding leaves, while curved wood-grain marks add smaller details to the simple trunk-shaped body.

pages.title: Hestu Playing His Maracas in Korok Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: Hestu plays his maracas in Korok Forest in this printable coloring page, raising two round patterned instruments beneath the broad leafy canopy above his leaf-mask face. A small leaf-decorated pouch hangs across his body, while bark contours, drifting leaves, mushrooms, and stones provide additional shapes around the large central figure.

pages.title: The Hylian Crest with the Triforce and Outstretched Wings Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page presents the Hylian Crest with the Triforce and outstretched wings, centered alone with bold outlines and a pointed lower tail beneath the emblem. Symmetrical feather sections, curled upper contours, and three triangular Triforce pieces create distinct enclosed spaces, while the plain background keeps the Zelda emblem prominent.

pages.title: The Master Sword Resting in Its Pedestal in Korok Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: The Master Sword rests in its pedestal in Korok Forest in this printable coloring page, with a winged guard, wrapped grip, and faceted pommel above the blade. A Triforce marks the cracked stone base, while surrounding tree trunks, rounded boulders, and leafy plants add varied sections around the tall central sword.

pages.title: The Master Sword and Hylian Shield Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page pairs the Master Sword and Hylian Shield, with the long blade planted among rocks beside the shield's large Triforce and bird emblems. The wrapped sword grip, faceted central guard detail, shield studs, and angular border provide smaller sections above scattered grass and cracked stone faces.

pages.title: The Ocarina of Time Beside the Three Spiritual Stones Coloring Page
pages.description: The Ocarina of Time rests beside the three Spiritual Stones in this printable coloring page, with round finger holes above a cracked rock platform and grass. Spiral, flame, and crescent-like symbols distinguish the faceted stones, while the instrument's broad curved body and Triforce-marked mouthpiece provide larger enclosed areas on the coloring sheet.
